root_cause: The v1 replica contract declared deterministic non-thinking execution, but the OpenAI-compatible Worker backend had no deployment-scoped reasoning_effort binding. Ollama therefore spent the 256-token limit in hidden reasoning and returned empty visible content with finish_reason=length.
diagnostic_evidence: A direct request with /no_think reproduced hidden reasoning and finish_reason=length. The same endpoint and model with reasoning_effort=none returned visible content and finish_reason=stop.
fix_scope: Add optional reasoning_effort to openai_compatible backend configuration, defaulting to null to preserve frozen M4 behavior; set reasoning_effort=none only on the two v1 equivalent deployments.
